## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior, security boundary, or maintenance change.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests, type-check, and build pass.
- [ ] `pnpm policy:repository` passes.
- [ ] No real conversation export, report, credential, personal data, or unredacted log is included.
- [ ] Privacy, security, and documentation claims still match the implementation.

## Sensitive changes

If this changes scanning, redaction, output fields, file access, network behavior, dependencies,
GitHub Actions, or Gitleaks exceptions, explain the boundary and obtain an independent review.
Never paste sensitive evidence into this pull request.
